1138813.title: nanoid: custom generators can loop indefinitely when size is zero
1138813.reason: Nanoid 3.x is pulled only by the Vite/PostCSS test and build toolchain; published Specky packages do not ship devDependencies or expose Nanoid generators to user input. No corrected Nanoid 3.x release is currently published.
1138813.expiresWhen: Remove when Nanoid publishes 3.3.17 or later in the 3.x line, or when PostCSS no longer depends on the affected line.
